subtitle: From Konkan Accountant to Architect of the Maratha State

panels.shot: low-angle mid-shot with distant Mughal Delhi skyline on one side and the forts of the Deccan on the other
panels.action: Balaji Vishwanath Bhat stands calm yet resolute between a hazy vision of Mughal domes and the rugged silhouettes of Deccan forts, holding a rolled farman in one hand and a ledger in the other.

dialogue.text: In the troubled years after Aurangzeb, Balaji Vishwanath Bhat rose from Konkan accounts to write a new Maratha state into the very ledgers of empire.

i18n.hi: औरंगज़ेब के बाद की उथल–पुथल में, कोंकण का मुनीम बालाजी विश्वनाथ भट ने मराठा राज्य को साम्राज्य की बहियों में लिख डाला।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of the Konkan coast and a modest village house
panels.action: A young Balaji Vishwanath Bhat sits cross-legged in a dim Konkan house, oil lamp flickering as he writes carefully on palm-leaf accounts while monsoon clouds brood over the coconut-lined coast outside.

dialogue.text: He was not born into a fort or a war camp. Balaji Vishwanath learned his craft among ledgers, rains and salt air along the Konkan coast.

i18n.hi: वो न किले में जन्मा, न छावनी में। बालाजी ने हूनर सीखा कागज़, बारिश और नमकीन कोंकणी हवा के बीच।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder close-up of Balaji writing accounts
panels.action: Balaji leans over a wooden desk, neat columns of figures and names spreading across a long sheet, his brow calm but intent as a faint clamour of soldiers and villagers filters in from outside.

dialogue.text: Around him, Maratha power was still a patchwork of forts and chiefs. In his hands, scattered dues and promises began to take the shape of a system.

i18n.hi: उसके चारों तरफ मराठा ताकत बस किलों और सरदारों की रजाई थी। उसकी मुट्ठी में बिखरे कर–खिराज एक नए निज़ाम का रूप लेने लगे।

panels.shot: medium shot in a Maratha military camp tent, papers spread out
panels.action: Now older, Balaji stands in a campaign tent lit by torches, pointing with a stylus at maps and account scrolls laid before grim sardars in armour, as distant drums and neighing horses hint at war outside.

dialogue.text: He moved from village books to camp chanceries, where silver, grain and horse fodder mattered as much as courage. He learned how a kingdom eats, marches and pays.

i18n.hi: वो गाँव की बहियों से छावनी की दफ्तरी में पहुँचा, जहाँ चाँदी, अनाज और चारे की उतनी ही कीमत थी जितनी बहादुरी की। उसने समझा, राज्य खाता–पीता, चलता और चुकाता कैसे है।

panels.shot: wide shot of Satara palace hall with Shahu on a distant throne and Balaji in the foreground
panels.action: Inside the Satara court, Shahu sits on a raised seat in sober splendour while courtiers form wary clusters; in the foreground, Balaji stands slightly apart with a calm, observant face, a bundle of records in his hands.

dialogue.text: By the time Shahu claimed his grandfather’s mantle, the Maratha court was a field of rival claims. Balaji brought not banners, but order to Shahu’s fragile throne.

i18n.hi: जब शाहू ने दादा की गादी माँगी, दरबार दावों से भरा अखाड़ा था। बालाजी ने झंडों की नहीं, अनुशासन की फौज शाहू के नाज़ुक तख़्त के नीचे खड़ी की।

panels.shot: close, dignified mid-shot of Balaji receiving a ceremonial robe in court
panels.action: A court attendant drapes an embroidered robe over a composed Balaji as senior nobles watch; his posture remains modest, his fingers still holding a folded memorandum even as the honour is bestowed.

dialogue.text: In 1713, Shahu made him Peshwa. It was more than a title. It meant the pen that balanced war and revenue would now sit in one patient Konkan hand.

i18n.hi: १७१३ में शाहू ने उसे पेशवा बनाया। ये सिर्फ ओहदा नहीं था, ये उस कलम को सौंपना था जो जंग और महसूल दोनों का हिसाब बराबर रखे।

panels.shot: bird's-eye shot of the Deccan with overlaid suggestion of routes and revenue circuits
panels.action: From high above, dusty roads wind between Deccan forts and market towns as tiny Maratha horsemen ride along; translucent lines hint at chauth circuits spreading across six Mughal provinces of the Deccan.

dialogue.text: The Marathas already claimed chauth and sardeshmukhi across the six Deccan provinces. But these dues were won by raids and memory. Balaji sought to turn them into recognized rights.

i18n.hi: छः दक्खनी सूबों से मराठे चौथ–सरदेशमुखी माँगते थे, पर ये हक़ बस धावों और यादों के दम पर था। बालाजी ने इन्हें लिखी हुई हक़दारी बनाना चाहा।

panels.shot: medium shot of Balaji at a low desk with Modi-script letters and seals
panels.action: Balaji sits in a quiet Satara office, surrounded by piles of Modi-script letters, wax seals and rough maps, as he dictates to a scribe while tracing routes with his finger.

dialogue.text: In the Peshwa daftar, he stitched scattered pattis, sanads and promises into a fiscal constitution: which village owed what, to whom, and under whose seal.

i18n.hi: पेशवा दफ्तर में उसने बिखरे पट्टे, सनदें और वादे जोड़कर नया मालीयाती निज़ाम बुना—कौन गाँव किसे कितना देगा, किस मुहर के नीचे।

panels.shot: wide shot of Satara court with nobles debating, Balaji listening
panels.action: Nobles with drawn brows argue in the hall, some gesturing toward distant Delhi, others toward the Deccan; Balaji stands slightly to one side, listening in silence, a rolled letter from the north in his hand.

dialogue.text: Meanwhile in Delhi, emperors were made and unmade by favourites. News of the Syed Brothers’ rise reached Satara. Shahu’s men argued: fight, raid, or bargain?

i18n.hi: उधर दिल्ली में बादशाह वज़ीरों के हाथ की कठपुतली थे। सय्यद बंधुओं के उभार की ख़बर सतारा पहुँची। शाहू के लोग उलझे: लड़ें, लूटें या सौदा करें?

panels.shot: low-angle close-up of Balaji’s face, lit by lamp, thoughtful
panels.action: In a dim chamber, Balaji’s face is half in shadow, eyes steady as he reads a Persian letter bearing imperial seals, the flame of a single lamp steady beside him.

dialogue.text: Balaji saw a different road: help decide who sat on the Mughal throne, and in return, make the empire itself write the Maratha claims into law.

i18n.hi: बालाजी ने और राह देखी: तय करो गद्दी पर कौन बैठे, बदले में खुद साम्राज्य से मराठों के हक कागज़ पर लिखवा लो।

panels.shot: wide shot of a Maratha column marching north across the plains
panels.action: A long Maratha column rides across the dusty plains under a pale sky, standards fluttering; Balaji rides in a palanquin amid the horsemen, surrounded by scribes and guards rather than armoured captains.

dialogue.text: In 1719, he went north with Maratha strength at his back. Not as a conqueror of Delhi, but as an arbiter in its civil war.

i18n.hi: १७१९ में वो उत्तर चला, मराठा ताकत पीठ पर। दिल्ली जीतने के हमलावर की तरह नहीं, उसकी गृहयुद्ध का पंच बनकर।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of Mughal Delhi skyline and Red Fort
panels.action: The red walls and domes of imperial Delhi rise behind the Yamuna, with Mughal banners drooping in the heat as small Maratha contingents and imperial troops face each other cautiously beyond the river.

dialogue.text: Delhi still glittered, but its marble hid fractures. The Syed Brothers needed allies. Balaji offered soldiers and pressure, not submission.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली अब भी चमकती थी, पर संगमरमर में दरारें थीं। सय्यद बंधुओं को साथी चाहिए थे। बालाजी ने फौज और दबाव दिया, सिर झुकाकर नहीं।

panels.shot: intimate interior shot in a Mughal tent, Balaji seated across from a Persian noble
panels.action: Inside an elegant Mughal pavilion, Balaji sits upright on a low carpet opposite a richly robed noble, a Persian inscription on a hanging behind; between them lies a blank farman with inkwell and pen ready.

dialogue.text: In the language of khilats and farmans, he pressed his case: Maratha support for the Syeds’ emperor, in return for written recognition of chauth and sardeshmukhi in the Deccan.

i18n.hi: ख़िलअतों और फ़रमानों की ज़बान में उसने सौदा रखा: सय्यदों के बादशाह को मराठा मदद, बदले में दक्खन में चौथ–सरदेशमुखी का लिखित हुक्म।

panels.shot: close-up of imperial hand signing a farman, Balaji’s hand steadying the page
panels.action: An imperial hand, heavy with rings, moves a pen across the parchment, while Balaji’s steady fingers hold the edge of the farman flat, the faint outline of Deccan place names visible.

dialogue.text: The farmans that followed named the six Deccan provinces and granted Marathas the right to collect their shares. Raids became revenues; assertion became recognized sovereignty.

i18n.hi: जो फ़रमान निकले, उनमें छः दक्खनी सूबों के नाम और मराठों का हिस्सा लिख गया। धावे महसूल बने, ज़ोर–जबर बन गई मान्यता प्राप्त हकूमत।

panels.shot: medium shot in a Mughal courtyard, Yesubai being escorted out as Balaji watches
panels.action: In a shaded Mughal courtyard, Yesubai steps out from behind a lattice screen, veiled yet dignified, as women attendants and guards accompany her; at a distance, Balaji stands still, his face softening with relief.

dialogue.text: Another clause released Shahu’s mother, Yesubai, from Mughal prison. The settlement was not only about silver; it was about honour and the memory of Shivaji’s house.

i18n.hi: एक और शर्त में शाहू माँ, यसूबाई, को मुग़़ल कैद से छुड़ाया। ये सौदा सिर्फ चाँदी का नहीं था, इज़्ज़त और शिवाजी घराने की याद का भी था।

panels.shot: wide shot of Satara court welcoming Balaji’s return, with documents presented to Shahu
panels.action: Back in Satara, Shahu sits forward on his throne as Balaji kneels, offering a bundle of sealed farmans; courtiers look on, some awed, some wary, as guards stand rank on rank behind.

dialogue.speaker: balaji_vishwanath_bhat
dialogue.text: Maharaj, the empire itself has written our rights. Now we must keep them.

i18n.hi: महाराज, अब खुद साम्राज्य ने हमारे हक लिख दिए हैं। अब हमें ही उन्हें निभाना है।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder shot of Balaji instructing younger officials in the daftar
panels.action: In the humming Peshwa office, Balaji stands over a long table as young officials copy entries from the imperial farmans into Modi-script registers, while runners come and go with village reports.

dialogue.text: He then did the slower work: folding imperial grants into Maratha registers, training men who could read both Persian and Modi, binding distant villages to Satara through ink.

i18n.hi: फिर उसने धीमा काम किया: बादशाही फ़रमान मराठा बहियों में घोले, फ़ारसी और मोडी दोनों पढ़ने वाले मुनीम तैयार किए, दूर–दराज़ के गाँवों को स्याही से सतारा से बाँध दिया।

panels.shot: medium shot of Balaji in Pune, overlooking warehouses and markets
panels.action: Balaji stands on a terrace in Pune, watching bullock carts and grain sacks move in orderly lines into new warehouses, as scribes tally arrivals and soldiers guard the gates.

dialogue.text: Power began to tilt from the old hill capital to Pune, where revenues, records and officers could be managed like a great machine. The Peshwa’s seat was becoming the real centre.

i18n.hi: ताकत पुराने पहाड़ी दरबार से खिसककर पुणे की तरफ झुकने लगी, जहाँ महसूल, रजिस्टर और हाकिम एक बड़ी मशीन की तरह चलाए जा सके। पेशवा की गद्दी असली केंद्र बनती गई।

panels.shot: intimate interior shot of Balaji with his son Bajirao by lamplight
panels.action: By lamplight, an aging Balaji sits with his young son Bajirao in a quiet chamber, placing a hand on his shoulder as open ledgers and a sheathed sword lie side by side before them.

dialogue.text: When illness bent his body, he prepared his son Bajirao to inherit not just an office, but a structure: armies funded by regular dues, chiefs bound by shares in a wider Maratha commonwealth.

i18n.hi: जब बीमारी ने देह झुका दी, उसने बेटे बाजीराव को सिर्फ कुर्सी नहीं, ढांचा सौंपा—नियमित महसूल से चलने वाली फौजें, और हिस्सेदारी से बँधे सरदार, एक बड़े मराठा संघ–राज्य में।

panels.shot: solemn close-up of Balaji resting, eyes closed, with records beside him
panels.action: Balaji lies on a simple bed, eyes gently closed, a rolled farman and a worn account book resting on a low stool near his hand, as a shutter lets in the soft light of dawn.

dialogue.text: Balaji Vishwanath died in 1720, the same year Bajirao was made Peshwa. His office had quietly become hereditary, turning a royal advisor into the pivot of a confederacy.

i18n.hi: १७२० में बालाजी विश्वनाथ की मौत हुई, उसी साल बाजीराव पेशवा बना। ये ओहदा चुपचाप वंशानुगत हो चुका था, राजा के सलाहकार को संघराज्य के धुरी में बदलते हुए।

panels.shot: broad, contemplative aerial shot of the Deccan and north India with faint traces of Maratha routes and forts
panels.action: From high above, the Deccan hills and northern plains stretch to the horizon, faint lines showing Maratha routes, forts and revenue circuits that will later expand, while distant clouds cast shifting shadows over the land.

dialogue.text: Battles would be won and lost, and dynasties would rise and fall. But the fiscal-military frame Balaji forged—of chauth, sardeshmukhi and a Peshwa’s statecraft—outlived the victories that first made it possible.

i18n.hi: लड़ाइयाँ जीत–हार देखेंगी, खानदान उठेंगे–गिरेंगे। पर चौथ, सरदेशमुखी और पेशवा की सूझ–बूझ से गढ़ा जो महसूल–फौजी ढांचा था, वो उन सारी फ़तहों से आगे तक जियेगा।

title_i18n.en: Balaji Vishwanath Writes a New State
title_i18n.hi: बालाजी विश्वनाथ लिखता है नया राज्य

subtitle_i18n.en: From Konkan Accountant to Architect of the Maratha State
subtitle_i18n.hi: कोंकण के मुनीम से मराठा राज्य का शिल्पकार
